description:
Wire UI controls that issue user actions exclusively as
lernie <subcommand> invocations, per ARCH §3.5 / §3.4.

=== Scope ===

1. New-prompt input: a text field + button at the bottom of the
   render. Submit exec's lernie prompt <repo> <message> via the
   existing cli_outbound::Cli::run wrapper, with --stream when
   Phase 7 lands so the streaming pane (also Phase 7) updates
   live. The repo path comes from AppState.

2. Stop button: while a prompt subprocess is running, render a
   stop button. Click triggers cli_outbound's existing
   SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL drop path explicitly (currently only fires
   on the wrapper drop; expose a public stop() that does the same
   work).

3. Resume button: NOT in this phase. lernie resume <repo>
   re-enters the workflow state machine per ARCH §1 / §6 / §603,
   and the workflow state machine itself is v0.6 work. v0.5 lands
   without a resume trigger; the v0.6 epic will add the subcommand
   and the UI button together.

=== Constraints ===

- All commands go through cli_outbound. No direct std::process or
  std::os::unix calls outside that module.
- No persistent state — the action handlers read AppState (which
  is itself derived from filesystem) and exec the right CLI.
- 100% line coverage; cli_outbound tests cover the new stop()
  surface.

=== Dependencies ===

Hard: bl-51d9 (Phase 7) — the streaming pane needs lernie prompt
--stream so the new-prompt action has something to render.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: v0.5 Phase 9: user-action triggers (new prompt, stop)
